label: Mollie payments
description: One record per Mollie payment the app creates at checkout. The safety net uses them to find shoppers who paid but never got an order.

source.description: Who created the record. The app sets 'checkout'; records without it are rejected (functions/reject-manual-payments.ts).

mode.description: Mollie mode of the API key that created the payment

cart_id.description: Cart the payment was created for

order_id.description: Order the payment belongs to, once there is one

amount.description: Amount the shopper was asked to pay

mollie_status.description: Last status seen on Mollie: open, pending, authorized, paid, canceled, expired or failed

resolution.description: pending: waiting for the shopper. completed: paid through checkout. recovered: the safety net created the order. unmatched: paid, but no order could be created (the merchant must act). resolved: the merchant handled it. abandoned: never paid.

note.description: Why a payment is unmatched, or what the merchant did about it

reason.description: Short reason shown in the list (e.g. Order unpaid); the full explanation is in note

amount_display.description: Display copy of the amount, e.g. EUR 10.00

order_number.description: Display copy of the order number

mollie_url.description: Link to the payment in the Mollie dashboard

date_paid.description: When the safety net first saw the payment as paid

types.description: A shopper paid on Mollie but the app couldn't create their order
